title: Conceptacle

inlines.v: CONCEPTACLE, noun [Latin , See Conceive.] 1. That in which any thing is contained; a vessel; a receiver, or receptacle. 2. In botany, a follicle; a pericarp of one valve, opening longitudinally on one side and having the seeds loose in it.
